column3: Kuroneko Route · Relaxing in her room
When will Kuroneko come back...?
After that, she did return once---
Phew... I sweated a bit.
Sorry, I'll need to leave again. It shouldn't take too long this time.
Even though that's what she said...
It shouldn't take too long this time, she said, but it sure has been a while...
What's she doing? I don't think she left the house...
Hey～ Kuroneko～? Where are you～?
No reply...
Kuroneko～?
...In the shower...?
*gulp*
Ah...
W-Why are you here...?
N-No... Well...
W-What are you here for...?
Ah... Well～...
C-C-Could...it be, that...
H-How would I... I wouldn't do such a thing like peeping...!
...P-Peeping...?
...You're the worst. I despise you.
Ah, about this... Kuroneko-san?
What? Under such circumstances, if you have something to say for me to forgive you, you better speak out.
I also don't wish to hand over someone I know to the police...
No, I'm not peeping! I'm not a criminal caught red-handed either! I just happened to be here!
And you just started listening here...?
N-No... Although it's as you say in the end...
...Is that so. No wonder you were once called "sexual harassment senpai".
G-Guh...
...I'm going to change into my clothes now.
Y-Yeah...
Please return and continue your work.
I-I get it.
At the same time, forget everything you just saw.
Ah, eh? T-That's a little tough...
I can help you forget everything if you can't do it yourself.
Luckily, there's something conveniently used as a torturing tool called "water" right here.
I-I get it, I will forget about it! I can forget it! At the very least I won't tell anyone about it!
If you were to tell anyone...
I-I said I won't, didn't I!?
The flames of hell will burn you. Also, the burnt ashes will be dispersed. Lastly, your soul that doesn't have a place to return to will be purified...
...I think I'll get back to doing my work carefully now.
